scope: read-only analysis; no firmware build, no device access, no flash, no OTA, no MIDI/USB traffic
question: Can S1-C2 avoid a new private parser by composing exact official v15 product SysEx acceptance with live-proven H2 producer semantics into an atomic two-slot scheme?
short_answer: Not safely with the existing official complete-message handler and H2 producer ABI. A fixed-order two-product-packet state machine is atomic in the abstract only if additional firmware code proves exact accepted length/source identity and slot sequence before publication. Current official direct product handling does not expose those invariants to the H2 producer and does not carry note/slot identity.

exact_addresses.completed_message_callsite: 0x0202d202 calls 0x0201e254 with r0=assembled message and r1=accumulated length
exact_addresses.h2_producer: 0x0201e1a2..0x0201e1ec; receives only r0=accepted staging pointer, uses lock 0x01c465bd, copies to 0x01c46520, stores valid 0x01c465bc last

alternatives.name: two exact direct official product packets, first-to-slot0 second-to-slot1
alternatives.reason: Direct official path does not prove r9==0xa3 and calls producer with only a stage pointer. A short or malformed final-F7 packet can enter the producer after partially refreshing stage, and the producer cannot distinguish it from the exact live packet without new length/message validation. Official product bytes also carry no note/slot identity. Host ordering alone is not a firmware invariant.

alternatives.name: two segmented/final official product packets only
alternatives.reason: The segmented final path has a useful accumulated-length gate, but current H2 accepts both direct and segmented product paths and the producer cannot identify which caller invoked it. Making segmented-only safe would require proving direct path cannot mutate private state, or adding caller/length discrimination. That is new code and exact placement remains unproved.

alternatives.name: staging shadow copies with activation-last state
alternatives.reason: LOADING can hide a first accepted copy and ARMED-last can prevent partial consumption after an interrupted first packet. It does not validate that the copied bytes came from two exact product messages, does not bind both messages as a set, and does not encode notes.

alternatives.name: generation counters on sequential official packets
alternatives.reason: Generation counters can detect replacement races only if consumers compare active generations across Note On and Note Off. S1-C1/S1-C2 load-once immutability avoids that race without counters. Counters do not prove exact packet length, transaction binding, or slot identity.

alternatives.name: double buffering for active and staging two-slot sets
alternatives.reason: True double buffering needs an inactive two-slot set in addition to the active set, at least another 0x140 bytes plus metadata. The admitted S1-C1/S1-C2 boundary reserves only 0x01c46520..0x01c46660. It also still needs a selector for which inactive buffer receives a packet.

strict_invariants_required_if_unblocked: Before ARMED, no Ch10 consumer may read slot0 or slot1 for the private two-slot scheme.
STATE=LOADING must be stored before the first private copy can publish valid0.
valid0 must be stored after the complete slot0 0x9c copy, but valid0 alone must not make slot0 consumable while state is LOADING.
valid1 must be stored after the complete slot1 0x9c copy, and STATE=ARMED must be stored last after a csync/order barrier.
After ARMED, every official product producer entry must reject without mutation until reboot or an independently proven inactive double buffer exists.
The firmware, not only the host script, must distinguish exact accepted packets from partial, short, oversized, duplicate, replayed, or wrong-route packets before any consumable publication.
The same note-to-slot rule must be used by Note On and Note Off, with fallback restoring the H2-correct memcpy destination.

smallest_discriminator.statement: Prove, by static rows and exact bytes only, that a replacement producer at the accepted product callsites can know or enforce exact payload length and route (direct versus segmented) and can fit an EMPTY/LOADING/ARMED two-copy state machine in owned executable space while preserving H2 fallback/reload behavior. The smallest negative/positive test is an offline ABI/placement discriminator for 0x0201e468 and 0x0201e49c, not a firmware build or live packet.
minimum_evidence: At producer entry, identify a reliable register or memory field containing exact accepted total/payload length, or prove direct 0x0201e468 is neutralized for private publication and only segmented 0x0201e49c can publish.

Identify how slot index and note identity are determined without corrupting the 156-byte official runtime voice payload. Fixed notes 36/45 are acceptable only for a narrow discriminator and must be stated as firmware constants.
Assemble/decode the producer state machine and prove it fits the remaining owned cave with all branch/call reach, unlock-on-reject paths, and unchanged nonprivate official/H2 behavior.
